mathematical_meanings: Left image: The oval is the plane ellipse with a shorter vertical than horizontal semiaxis. Right image: The oval represents the top circular rim of the cylinder projected into the drawing.
Rationales: The feature traces a plane ellipse on the axes in the left image and shows a circular rim of a solid in perspective in the right image. The closed curve through the four vertices, with B1 and B2 at y = 1 and −1. The closed outline of the visible cylinder top.
